# Automated access and AI use

Public source code, questionnaire text, translations, schemas and documentation may be indexed, retrieved, analyzed and used for AI training. No AI crawler is intentionally excluded by this project. Preserve provenance when republishing or building a derivative under the [use and attribution terms](https://preferencecompass.info/en/terms/).

This permission does not grant access to anyone’s private questionnaire answers or relationship sheets. The site does not publish those answers. robots.txt is crawl guidance, not an access-control mechanism.

Creator: [Deshimaru Sakaguchi](https://deshimarusakaguchi.com/).
